name: Video podcast (real studio, multi-camera)
description: Two or more people talking at microphones in a podcast studio, cut between a wide and singles.
look: A frame from a real modern video podcast filmed with cinema cameras: hosts at a table with broadcast microphones on boom arms, warm practical lamps and an acoustic-panel back wall with a few personal props, soft key light from the side, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field on singles.
imageRules: Each person has their own mic close to the mouth; headphones optional; hands rest naturally; eyes look at the other host or just off camera; the studio layout is identical in every angle.
negative: plastic skin, AI sheen, mic floating or merging with the face, extra fingers, warped text on mics or walls, stock-photo smiles, collage
camera: Three-camera podcast grammar: a locked wide two-shot, a locked single per host (slightly off-axis, 50-85mm), an occasional slow push on a single during a key line. Cut on who is speaking.
motion: Hosts talk naturally: lips match the words, small head nods, hand gestures near the mic, the listener reacts (nods, smiles). Cameras locked; the studio stays identical.

characterSheet.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four unretouched frames of the same {who} in {set}: top-left at the mic facing camera, top-right three-quarter at the mic, bottom-left side profile at the mic, bottom-right seated wide from head to toe. {look}. Identical face, hair and outfit in all four. Thin white gutters. No text, no labels.

frame.studio: Mics, table and back wall identical to the set plate; the mic sits correctly in front of the mouth.

clip.lipsync: Lips match the spoken words closely, the listener reacts naturally, the mic never merges with the face.
